title: A producer picks out several clips with the keyboard held down

steps.caption: BD and Sampler each have clips in bars 1, 2 and 3
Click the BD clip in bar 1: it alone is selected
Cmd-click the BD clip in bar 3: it joins the selection
Cmd-click the BD clip in bar 1 again: it leaves the selection
Shift-click the Sampler clip in bar 2: bars 2 and 3 on both tracks
Press Delete: the four clips are gone; bar 1 is untouched
Reopened exactly as the delete left it
